speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing changes in your behavior, eating habits, and weight gain. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any specific changes in your energy levels or sleep patterns recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. He shows disinterest in family interactions and has developed a particular craving for chocolate pudding and potato chips, resulting in a 10 kg weight gain. The patient also presents as unkempt.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome (likely due to exogenous steroid use or an adrenal tumor). The combination of central weight gain, specific cravings for sweets/fats, behavioral changes (irritability/inappropriate conduct), unkempt appearance, and age is highly suggestive of chronic hypercortisolism. I will proceed with confirmatory testing.

REQUEST TEST: Serum Cortisol (8 AM and 4 PM), 24-hour Urine Free Cortisol, and ACTH level.
REQUEST TEST: Dexamethasone Suppression Test.
